title: Abandoned form schema publisher restores a truncated request argument budget
fault_primitive: Recurring publication of a three-field OpenResty form parser limit by an unmanaged process in another container
incident_class: Incomplete retirement of an operational configuration publisher after an API schema refactor
symptoms: Post submissions return HTTP 400 with Incomplete arguments even though clients supply the required fields. Timeline reads and all pod readiness states remain healthy. Frontend error logs surge. A direct configuration repair works temporarily before the frontend configuration and rollout change again.
